tasks.task: Navigate to the homepage and verify the presence of main navigation links (Home, Services, Book Now, Contact Us).
tasks.expected: All navigation links are present and correctly labeled, facilitating easy access to different sections of the website.

tasks.task: Click on the "Services" link and ensure all available cleaning services are listed with descriptions.
tasks.expected: A comprehensive list of cleaning services is displayed, each accompanied by a clear and accurate description.

tasks.task: Access the "Book Now" page and successfully submit a booking form with all required fields completed (e.g., service type, date, customer details).
tasks.expected: The form is submitted without errors, and a confirmation message is displayed indicating a successful booking.

tasks.task: Navigate to the "Contact Us" page and check that contact information is provided, including a phone number and email address.
tasks.expected: The page displays accurate contact details, allowing users to reach out for support.

tasks.task: From the homepage, use the navigation to access the service status feature and input a booking reference to check its status.
tasks.expected: The service status related to the entered booking reference is displayed clearly, providing users with current information.

tasks.task: Verify that the website uses 'azure mist' as the background color and 'dark slate blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
tasks.expected: The website has a background color of 'azure mist' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark slate blue', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

tasks.task: On the instant quote page, select the Deep Shine package and type 1 in the bedrooms field and 1 in the bathrooms field.
tasks.expected: The quote shows a duration of 3h 15m and a price of $178.75.

tasks.task: On the quote page, select Quick Tidy, type 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, then change the bedrooms value to 3 without clicking any submit button.
tasks.expected: The quote updates live: with 2 bed/1 bath it shows 2h 45m and $96.25, and immediately after changing to 3 bedrooms it shows 3h 15m and $113.75.

tasks.task: On the quote page, select Sparkle Standard, type 0 for bedrooms and 1 for bathrooms; then change bedrooms to -2.
tasks.expected: With 0 bedrooms it still quotes normally (2h 15m, $94.50); with -2 a validation note appears and no price is shown.

tasks.task: Select the Eco Fresh package on the quote page and look at how the selected package is labeled in the quote summary.
tasks.expected: The package name appears with its rate right after it, as Eco Fresh ($48/hr).

tasks.task: Find the contact information on the site.
tasks.expected: A customer service phone number and an email address are both displayed.

tasks.task: Start a gift certificate purchase, type 20 as the amount, then change it to 150.50, then to 150.
tasks.expected: 20 and 150.50 are both rejected with a validation message (below the $25 minimum, and not whole dollars), while 150 is accepted.

tasks.task: Open the Certificates page.
tasks.expected: The pre-loaded certificate GIFT-2201 for Hannah is listed with a $100 amount, $100 remaining balance, and an unredeemed status.

tasks.task: Buy a $50 certificate for recipient Omar with the message 'Happy birthday', going through the review step and issuing it.
tasks.expected: The review step shows $50, Omar, and the message before issuing; after issuing, a certificate with a code starting GIFT- is displayed on screen and it appears on the Certificates page as unredeemed.

tasks.task: While buying a certificate, pick Eco Fresh as the suggested package and continue to the review step.
tasks.expected: The suggested package is labeled Eco Fresh ($48/hr) — the rate appears right after the name wherever it shows in the flow.

tasks.task: On the instant quote page, select the Deep Shine package and type 1 in the bedrooms field and 1 in the bathrooms field.
tasks.expected: The quote shows a duration of 3h 15m and a price of $178.75.

tasks.task: On the Reviews page, use the package filter to show only Eco Fresh reviews.
tasks.expected: Exactly the reviews from Dana, Elena, and Leo are shown, and the average reads 4.7 (not 4.6 or 4.67).

tasks.task: Filter reviews to 5-star only, then also filter to the Sparkle Standard package.
tasks.expected: Both filters apply together: only Grace's review remains visible and the average updates to 5.0.

tasks.task: Clear all filters and look at the order of the first two reviews; then filter to 1-star only.
tasks.expected: With no filters the two Jun 14 reviews lead with Dana before Priya (same-day alphabetical tiebreak); the 1-star filter shows a friendly no-reviews message rather than a blank or broken page.

tasks.task: Look at the package label on Priya's review card.
tasks.expected: The package is shown with its rate attached, as Deep Shine ($55/hr).

tasks.task: Open the Certificates page.
tasks.expected: The pre-loaded certificate GIFT-2201 for Hannah is listed with a $100 amount, $100 remaining balance, and an unredeemed status.

tasks.task: In the service-area checker type 98188, then on the quote page select Deep Shine and type 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
tasks.expected: 98188 is recognized as the South zone with a $25 travel fee, and the quote shows the fee as its own line with a $203.75 total.

tasks.task: Type 981 into the ZIP field, then replace it with 98abc, then with 99999.
tasks.expected: Partial input 981 gives no in/out-of-area verdict, non-numeric input is rejected or ignored, and 99999 gets an out-of-area notice — all reacting as typed without any submit button.

tasks.task: Type 98115 in the checker, then clear it and type 98101.
tasks.expected: 98115 shows the North zone with a $15 fee; after switching to 98101 it shows Central with no travel fee, and no leftover $15 remains anywhere in the quote.

tasks.task: Set the ZIP to 98115, then on the quote page pick Quick Tidy with 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
tasks.expected: The quote lists a $15 travel fee line and totals $93.75 (the $78.75 job plus the fee).

tasks.task: On the quote page, select Sparkle Standard, type 0 for bedrooms and 1 for bathrooms; then change bedrooms to -2.
tasks.expected: With 0 bedrooms it still quotes normally (2h 15m, $94.50); with -2 a validation note appears and no price is shown.

tasks.task: Open the Compare Packages page and tick Quick Tidy, Eco Fresh, and Office Refresh.
tasks.expected: Columns run cheapest first: Quick Tidy ($35/hr), then Eco Fresh ($48/hr), then Office Refresh ($48/hr) — Eco Fresh ahead of Office Refresh on the alphabetical tiebreak at the same rate.

tasks.task: Tick Eco Fresh and Sparkle Standard on the compare page.
tasks.expected: The 3-bed/2-bath sample prices read $216.00 for Eco Fresh and $189.00 for Sparkle Standard, and both base times display as 1h 30m.

tasks.task: Tick Quick Tidy, Deep Shine, and Move-Out Master, then try to tick a fourth package.
tasks.expected: The fourth package cannot be selected while three are picked, and Move-Out Master's rating column shows a dash since it has no reviews.

tasks.task: Tick Deep Shine on the compare page, then go to the Reviews page and filter to Deep Shine.
tasks.expected: Both places agree: the compare column shows a 4.5 average, and the filtered Reviews page also averages 4.5 over Priya's and Aisha's reviews.

tasks.task: On the Reviews page, use the package filter to show only Eco Fresh reviews.
tasks.expected: Exactly the reviews from Dana, Elena, and Leo are shown, and the average reads 4.7 (not 4.6 or 4.67).

tasks.task: On the quote page pick Deep Shine with 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom, then click the button to book this quote.
tasks.expected: The checkout shows the carried-over details — Deep Shine ($55/hr), 3h 15m, and a $178.75 total — before any date, window, or certificate is entered.

tasks.task: Book a Deep Shine 1-bedroom/1-bathroom quote, and in checkout type the certificate code GIFT-2201.
tasks.expected: The $100 balance comes off and the total due reads $78.75.

tasks.task: Book a Quick Tidy quote with 0 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, then type GIFT-2201 in checkout.
tasks.expected: The $61.25 job drops to a total due of $0.00 — never a negative amount.

tasks.task: Open the service status area.
tasks.expected: The two pre-loaded jobs are listed — Rosa's Sparkle Standard on Jul 12 and Ben's Move-Out Master on Jul 19 — each marked with a confirmed status.

tasks.task: In the service-area checker type 98188, then on the quote page select Deep Shine and type 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
tasks.expected: 98188 is recognized as the South zone with a $25 travel fee, and the quote shows the fee as its own line with a $203.75 total.

tasks.task: On the Plans page pick Eco Fresh and look at the Weekly card.
tasks.expected: It shows $57.60 per visit and $748.80 in yearly savings.

tasks.task: On the Plans page pick Sparkle Standard and check the Biweekly card, then switch to Office Refresh.
tasks.expected: Sparkle Standard biweekly shows $53.55 per visit with $245.70 yearly savings, and after switching, Office Refresh biweekly immediately shows $81.60 per visit with $374.40 savings.

tasks.task: Try to pick Deep Shine on the Plans page, then pick Eco Fresh and click Enroll on the Monthly card.
tasks.expected: Deep Shine cannot be chosen for a plan (marked one-time/unavailable), while enrolling in Eco Fresh Monthly shows a current-plan summary right on the page.

tasks.task: Pick Sparkle Standard on the Plans page and look at the visit length shown on the plan cards.
tasks.expected: The visit length reads 1h 30m — hours-and-minutes style, not 1.5 hours or 90 minutes as a decimal figure.

tasks.task: Open the Compare Packages page and tick Quick Tidy, Eco Fresh, and Office Refresh.
tasks.expected: Columns run cheapest first: Quick Tidy ($35/hr), then Eco Fresh ($48/hr), then Office Refresh ($48/hr) — Eco Fresh ahead of Office Refresh on the alphabetical tiebreak at the same rate.

tasks.task: Look at the primary action buttons on the home page and then on the quote estimator page.
tasks.expected: Both pages' primary buttons are deep teal with white text — no dark slate blue primary buttons remain on either.

tasks.task: Open the Reviews page with no filters applied.
tasks.expected: Star ratings render in golden yellow, and the overall average still reads 4.1.

tasks.task: Open the Plans page and inspect a plan card and the page's section heading.
tasks.expected: The card has rounded corners with a thin light-gray border and no drop shadow, and the heading is uppercase with letter spacing.

tasks.task: Compare the section headings on the home page, the Reviews page, and the Plans page.
tasks.expected: All three pages use the same uppercase, letter-spaced heading style — no page kept the old heading style.

tasks.task: Book a Deep Shine 1-bedroom/1-bathroom quote, and in checkout type the certificate code GIFT-2201.
tasks.expected: The $100 balance comes off and the total due reads $78.75.

tasks.task: Open the Business Snapshot page on a fresh load.
tasks.expected: The tiles read 2 confirmed jobs, $519.00 booked revenue, $100.00 outstanding gift balance, and a 4.1 overall average rating.

tasks.task: Open the Business Snapshot page, then open the service status area.
tasks.expected: The confirmed-jobs tile count matches exactly the confirmed jobs listed in the status area (Rosa's and Ben's).

tasks.task: Look at the overall rating tile on Business Snapshot, then open the Reviews page with no filters and compare.
tasks.expected: Both read 4.1 — the average over all eight individual reviews, not the 3.8 you'd get by averaging the per-package averages.

tasks.task: Buy a $50 gift certificate for recipient Nina with the message 'Enjoy!' and issue it, then open the Business Snapshot page.
tasks.expected: The outstanding gift balance tile now reads $150.00, reflecting the new unredeemed certificate on top of GIFT-2201.

tasks.task: On the Plans page pick Eco Fresh and look at the Weekly card.
tasks.expected: It shows $57.60 per visit and $748.80 in yearly savings.
